Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
SINDH FINANCE
ACT, 1990
1. Short title
and commencement.‑‑(l) This Act may be called the Sindh Finance
Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force on and from the 1st day
of July, 1990.

Definitions

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
SINDH FINANCE
ACT, 1990
2. Definitions: ‑In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context‑‑
(a) "Government" means the Government of
Sindh;
(b) "prescribed" means prescribed by rules;
(c) "rules" means rules made under this
Act.

6. Repeal of Sindh Ordinance XVII of 1977.‑‑The Court Fees
(Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1977, is hereby repealed.

ACT IV OF 1990

7. Amendment of Sindh Ordinance XIII of 1978.‑In the Court Fees
(Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1978, for the words "Twenty‑five
thousand rupees", the words "Fifty thousand rupees" shall be
substituted.

Licence for video film dealer

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
SINDH FINANCE
ACT, 1990
8. Licence for Video Film
Dealer.‑‑(1) No person shall engage in or carry on the business of
a Video film dealer, who deals in purchase or sale of, or lends on hire, video
films, except under a licence.
(2) The licence under
subsection (1) shall be issued by such authority in such form or renewed on
such terms and conditions as may be prescribed on payment of the fees mentioned
in the Schedule.

Penalty

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
SINDH FINANCE
ACT, 1990
9. Penalty.‑‑Whoever
contravenes the provisions of section 8 shall be liable to pay in addition to
licence fees a penalty not exceeding the amount of such fees.

Bar of suits in civil Court

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
SINDH FINANCE
ACT, 1990
10. Bar of suits in Civil
Court.‑‑No suit shall lie in any
Civil Court to set aside fee levied under this Act and the rules thereunder or
any penalty imposed under section 9.

Power to make rules

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
SINDH FINANCE
ACT, 1990
11. Power to make rules.‑‑Government
may make rules for carrying into effect the purposes of this Act.
